name: Synn
message: 「Man~, I'm so glad we nailed that sharp and crisp!! Yep, yep.」

name: Misa
message: 「We got laughed at so much, don't you feel anything at all!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It was fun, so what's the harm?」

name: Synn
message: 「All's well that ends well, so we're good, right?」

name: Ria
message: 「But I think it made us seem approachable, and it was a really nice greeting.」

name: Misa
message: 「There you go spoiling him again. You shouldn't do that, Senpai.」

name: Misa
message: 「This is why he's just slacking off instead of doing his handover work properly.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Our club activities keep us busy, so it can't be helped!」

name: Synn
message: 「All you're doing is eating cake, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The Sweets Club led by me!! It's a supremely grand panel of judges that evaluates and critiques every sweet thing in this world!! Hey, are you even listening to me!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That is right. We are very busy.」

name: Synn
message: 「Were you in a club or something?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I am busy trying out all kinds of clubs!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In short, you're in the go-home club.」

name: Misa
message: 「Exactly. In other words, those two are cut from the same cloth as Sakura-kun.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is an Edict of Pity for Our Own Kind.」

name: Ria
message: 「Everything up until now was just preparation anyway, so as long as you work hard starting today, there's no problem at all!」

name: Synn
message: 「Actually, standing up on stage made me realize just how much everyone is expecting from us.」

name: Synn
message: 「Now that we've taken the job, let's do it right. Um... err...」

name: Misa
message: 「Today's handover is the absolute most important part. How could you forget that...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Giggle. You were just that eager for \{this|\s12\s12}, weren't you?」

name: Misa
message: 「Th-That's not...! That's not it at all, it's just... how should I put it...\s03」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah, I've always admired it... To me, well... Senpai's 'Rosary' is...\s04」

name: Ria
message: 「Put this on and voila! A grand transformation into a proper Student Council member.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So exciting!! I want it right now!! Hand it over!」

name: Ria
message: 「This Rosary has been passed down through generations of the Ryuusei Student Council. It's... proof of being a Student Council member, I suppose.」

name: Synn
message: 「With this, anyone can tell at a glance that we're the Student Council, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「This year, I want everyone to wear these and do their best.」

name: Misa
message: 「No way... Senpai... You make it sound like this is your last duty...」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, all that's left now is cleaning up after ourselves.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There, there. You'll make Senpai uncomfortable if you cry.」

name: Ria
message: 「In the name of the Ryuusei Student Council and the Guardian Angels, do you swear to fulfill your duties as Student Council Secretary?」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go. Work hard from now on, okay?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh. She actually puts it around your neck herself. It really feels like a proper handover.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ufufu. To be honest, I kind of wanted one of these~」

name: Ria
message: 「In the name of the Ryuusei Student Council and the Guardian Angels, do you swear to fulfill your duties as Student Council Treasurer?」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go. Do your very best, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... Looks pretty much the same as usual to me. If I had to say, you look like Nanaka wearing a Rosary.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What kind of safe answer is that?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Doesn't that just mean you look cute as always?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You really are a kind person, Senpai~~」

name: Misa
message: 「This handover is a sacred ritual! Calming one's heart to receive it is basic courtesy, is it not?!」

name: Ria
message: 「There, there, calm down and be peaceful.」

name: Ria
message: 「Oh, you really don't need to be so formal.」

name: Misa
message: 「No! This long-cherished vow... You have no idea how long I have awaited this day...\s04」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She must be so happy to have become the Vice President.」

name: Ria
message: 「Do you swear, in the name of the Ryuusei Student Council and the Guardian Angels, to fulfill your duties as Vice President of the Student Council?」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go. Keep giving it your all from now on too, okay?」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai... I will definitely... no, I will never forget today for the rest of my life!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Do you swear, in the name of the Ryuusei Student Council and the Guardian Angels, to fulfill your duties as the Student Council President to the best of your ability?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh... Senpai, you're giving me the one you were wearing...!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Alright, Synn-kun. Come over here so I can pin it on you.\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh!? N-No, wait, doing that for the girls is more than enough!」

name: Ria
message: 「Now, now, no need to be shy.\s04」
Whoaaa! Senpai's huge chest is right in front of my eyes!?
Her breath feels like it's about to touch me, so I hold mine tight.
--Wait, I'm the Student Council President, so I shouldn't be thinking such improper thoughts! Bad, bad!

name: Ria
message: 「Oh? I can't quite get it right~」

name: Synn
message: 「I-If that's the case, wouldn't it be easier from behind~~~!?」

name: Ria
message: 「No way. That would mean giving everyone else preferential treatment, wouldn't it?」
In a way, I'm the one getting preferential treatment here!!
Something just pressed against my face... Only for a split second, something unbelievably soft...

name: Ria
message: 「Take good care of the academy and everyone from here on out, okay?\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「Kiii! I'm not jealous in the slightest!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Chewing on your handkerchief makes that rather unconvincing, you know.」

name: Ria
message: 「What I just did--next year, Synn-kun will be the one doing it.」
No way... Does that mean I'm going to press my chest against someone like that...?!

name: Ria
message: 「...Yep. Now we're officially the Student Council in both name and reality.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I haven't the faintest idea what we're supposed to do. The guidebook doesn't list anything specific either.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Senpai, tell us what we're supposed to do!」

name: Ria
message: 「Gosh. Fine then, Big Sister Ria will teach you!」
Under Ria-senpai's guidance, I gradually come to understand the duties of each officer--from secretary and treasurer to vice president.
Even if one particular person didn't seem entirely convinced...
Since it was Ria-senpai's reasoning, she reluctantly accepted.

name: Misa
message: 「Just because I accepted that doesn't mean I recognize you as the president!! Don't you forget it!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「--So, what about the most important one, the president?」

name: Misa
message: 「Senpai. I want to know too!! For future reference!」

name: Ria
message: 「To give it your absolute best... maybe?」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you saying? That's the hardest part of all, isn't it?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Specifically, what kind of things would that entail?」

name: Misa
message: 「Look!! The president's role belongs to Sakura-kun, right?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh. You just recognized Synn as president.」

name: Ria
message: 「If you do that, I'm sure good things will happen.」

name: Misa
message: 「A-A good thing!? N-No, sister, you mustn't! But, ah...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is it a good thing? Ufufu, that's wonderful then~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, anyway. Experience is the best teacher!」

name: Synn
message: 「I think... as President, you have to be able to handle any role, whether it's secretary, treasurer, or vice president.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yes, exactly!! Spot on!! That's precisely it!!」

name: Ria
message: 「As expected of someone chosen as Student Council President.\s04」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hmph! I knew that much too, you know!」

name: Ria
message: 「Alright then, that's all for today\s07 Thanks for your hard work, everyone♪」

name: Ria
message: 「I thought I'd sort through last year's files~」

name: Synn
message: 「It'll go faster if we all do it together. Senpai, isn't there something we can do to help?」

name: Misa
message: 「Guh! Senpai, I won't lose to Sakura-kun--I'll help out plenty, too!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Let's see... In that case, maybe I'll ask a whole lot of you!」

name: Ria
message: 「It really is fun... being together with everyone...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is it that time already? We'd better head to our club!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Today's my trial day for the Frisbee Dog Club♪ I get to play with dogs, so I'm really looking forward to it--\s07」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even though it's already autumn, you're still doing trial days...」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahhh... right. I actually have something I need to take care of too.」

name: Misa
message: 「What do you mean how come?! It's because it's just the t-t-t-t--\s03」

name: Synn
message: 「Could you not say embarrassing things like 'just the two of us'?\s01」

name: Misa
message: 「You were the one who said it originaly!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're just going to abandon helping your upperclassman?」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's do it together so we can go home sooner.」
Mnnn, she's really making this awkward~~.

name: Misa
message: 「Last year's event records, activity reports, and--」
She's completely ignoring me now. What insane concentration.

name: Synn
message: 「Woah! Amazing! She even finished my share...」
What should I do? Thanks to her, I have nothing left to do.

name: Synn
message: 「What should I do now... Oh right, my part-time job!!」
...Wait a minute. Didn't I quit my part-time job this morning?
My morning and evening milk delivery gig. Kind old man Amakawa even offered to give me free milk even though I quit...
That's right... Why did I quit my part-time job in the first place?
It was because I became Student Council President!!
Old man Amakawa said it! A real man must never look back on his former battlefield.
Time to switch gears. With this, I'm saying goodbye to my working-student life.
A sparkling school life awaits me now!!

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, has anything good actually happened since I became Student Council President?」
Senpai told me that if you try your hardest, good things will happen.
Which means I must not be trying hard enough yet!!
I don't really know what else to do, so I'll just start by cleaning!!

name: Synn
message: 「In this Student Council room... starting today, I'm... the Student Council President...」

name: Synn
message: 「I am the Ryuusei Student Council President, Synn Sakura!!」

name: Ria
message: 「And I am the former Ryuusei Student Council President, Ria Kujou!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Uh, well, I just found myself with nothing to do, so, um...」

name: Synn
message: 「Misa did most of it, so I...」

name: Ria
message: 「I can tell just by looking at you. You were doing some cleaning, weren't you?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ehem! Your Senpai sees right through everything!」

name: Ria
message: 「Thanks to everyone helping out, we finished early. Thank you all so much.\s07」

name: Ria
message: 「I guess all that's left is writing the activity log.」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooh, brand new. And a pack of five--what a steal.」

name: Ria
message: 「We can record what we did today in these, or write down notices for everyone.」

name: Synn
message: 「Kind of like a daily class log for whoever's on duty. But wait, isn't that the secretary's job...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Have you already forgotten what you said earlier?」

name: Ria
message: 「The president needs to be able to cover for the secretary too. No pawning your work off on others~ \s07」
She gently booped my nose with her soft finger.
I faced the notebook and tried to reflect on today's events, but...
We drank tea, greeted people, I got the Rosary, received some instruction from Senpai... did we do anything else?
Now then, is it really okay to just ramble about things like this...? Hmm, I'm at a loss.

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, nothing, just thinking about what to write...」

name: Ria
message: 「You don't need to try so hard. Relax, relax~ \s07」
Ria-senpai moved behind me. Then, she touched my hand.
And using my hand, she smoothly began to write something.
Ria-senpai's face was right beside mine, so close!!
Something just hit my shoulder from behind!!
This soft feeling is without a doubt... O-Oh, o-ohhh~~~
Her soft hands pull away. Stunned, I look down at what she wrote.

name: Ria
message: 「You just need to write stuff like this. Got it?」
I wonder if Senpai noticed... I won't be forgetting that touch anytime soon...
Senpai's face gets even closer!! If anyone sees us like this--
Of all people, Nanaka barge in!? This is bad!
Senpai... is already way over there.

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun was cleaning for us. It's squeaky clean now!」

name: Synn
message: 「What about you, Nanaka? What did you come here for?\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, I'm heading home with Sacchin after club practice today, so you can go ahead without me.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're going out for cake, aren't you?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「How many times do I have to tell you it's not cake, it's sweets!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And as for you, you went through all the trouble to become Student Council President, so stop cleaning and do some actual Student Council work!」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm. So you two walk home together~」

name: Synn
message: 「She says she's too scared to walk alone at night.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What did you say, you jerk!! Don't lie!」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then~~, since I got your childhood friend's permission, I was thinking... maybe you could help me out with Student Council work?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahahaha. Keep this a secret from everyone, okay?\s02」
She still had this many secret weapons left over?!
Together with Ria-senpai, I organized last year's activity records and replaced them with new ones for this year.
Even administrative paperwork somehow becomes fun when Senpai is around.
Besides, maybe I'll get to do some spicy things with Senpai again like before...
No, bad! I'm the Student Council President, I shouldn't be thinking about things like this!
Ah, but doing Student Council activities with Ria-senpai ends today...
